newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Jan-Sept sugar exports total 579,636 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Jan-Sept sugar exports total 579,636 tonnes.

text.p: Mexico has exported 579,636 tonnes of sugar between January and September, the national Sugar Chamber said Thursday.
In a statement, the umbrella group for Mexico's 61 sugar mills said imports in the same period totaled 96,357 tonnes.
Planned exports and imports for the remainder of the year, October to December were 69,885 tonnes and 57,654 tonnes, respectively, the chamber added.
The chamber, which does not normally release export and import figures, said it had decided to release sugar trade data because of recent reports of contraband sugar trade.

"It has been reported that there is contraband sugar dealings going on or illegal imports on the part of some of our members...so the chamber, in a bid to clarify the reports, is making public the exports and imports of sugar in the January-September period of 1996," it said.
